name: Aboleth
description: Enormous, antediluvian catfish covered in slime and tentacles. They hate all intelligent beings.

special_abilities.name: Curse
special_abilities.description: DC 15 CON or target gains a magical curse, turning into a deep one over 2d10 days.

special_abilities.name: Enslave
special_abilities.description: In place of attacks, one creature within far must make DC 15 WIS or the aboleth controls it for 1d4 rounds.

special_abilities.name: Telepathic
special_abilities.description: Read the thoughts of all creatures within far.
